about_the_game:
【Game Introduction】

This is a card game blended with light Roguelike adventure, and at the same time, a powerful card game editor. Build unique decks, challenge randomly generated levels, or create your very own card game world from scratch.

【Target Audience】

  • Card game enthusiasts who enjoy creating and playing with DIY content.

  • Independent card game developers, designers, and small-scale development teams.

【Key Features】

This software is a one-stop development solution tailored for card games. We've packaged underlying technical complexities into intuitive visual modules, empowering you to bring your ideas to life easily:

  • Rapid Prototyping: Design and create cards in minutes, with no programming knowledge required.

  • Deep Customization: Freely define card attributes, skill logic, game modes, and even entirely new rules.

  • Instant Testing & Validation: Automatically build game logic based on your configured data and test gameplay directly within the software.

  • Seamless Content Sharing: Share your creations and gather immediate player feedback through the integrated Steam Workshop, enabling continuous iteration.

  • Full Technical Enablement: Access source code licensing and technical support to significantly reduce development costs and cycles, making it exceptionally friendly for individuals and small teams.

【Core Modules】

  • Card Editor
    Comprehensively edit all aspects of your cards, including skills, art assets, sound effects, and more, supporting highly customized card creation.

  • Data Manager
    Centrally manage various structured game data across multiple dimensions, including game modes, arenas, expansions, classes, races, factions, skills, trigger conditions, and level design.

  • Steam Workshop Integration
    Easily publish, subscribe to, and rate community content, fostering a vibrant creator ecosystem.

【Version Information】

  • Beta Version (Free)
    Access and help test the latest in-development features. Please note this version may undergo periodic data resets and its content is subject to change.

  • Full Version (Paid)
    Provides a complete, stable game and editor experience, including all creation features and eligibility for ongoing updates.

name: Boss Key

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 or AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4600, NVIDIA GeForce 710, AMD Radeon R5 230 (OpenGL 3.2 Support)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 Ti, AMD Radeon HD 7850 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
